Gibraltar is a narrow peninsula running southwards from the south-west coast of Spain, with an area of 2½ square miles. It consists of a long, high mountain called The Rock and a sandy plain to the north of it, raised only a few feet above the level of the sea, called the North Front. Its greatest elevation is 1,396 feet, its length 2½ miles and its greatest breadth nearly 1 mile.

places.description: The Administrative Headquarters of the Group is in Vila, a town of from 2,000-2,500 inhabitants, on the island of Efate, which has a population of approximately 4,500. In recent years a second township, known as Santo, or Luganville, with a population of about 2,000, has grown up along the Segond Channel on the island of Santo. A manganese mine at Forari on Eastern Efate has a population of about 400 persons.
